    Class
    Description
    CitationAssembler
    Pure domain service that converts a list of RetrievedSource objects into a deduplicated, sequentially numbered list of SourceCitation records.
    CompanyClassifier
    Pure-Java domain service that applies keyword-based heuristics to classify companies into AI-healthcare subcategories and set coarse AI/health flags.
    CompanyDeduplicator
    Pure-Java domain service that deduplicates a list of companies by normalized name and (optionally) company-site domain.
    CompanyNewsletterRenderer
    Pure-Java domain service that renders a list of classified companies into newsletter-ready markdown grouped by AI-healthcare subcategory.
    DailyBriefingRenderer
    Renders a DailyBriefingData into personalized HTML and plain-text email content for one subscriber's daily briefing.
    DealEnrichmentService
    Domain service that enriches a DealSignal with cross-referenced context from sentiment, framework, regulatory, and company profile data.
    DigestNewsletterRenderer
    Renders the FREE-tier daily article digest newsletter by fetching recent RSS articles from the database and rendering them in an email-safe layout with a "Subscribe for AI analysis" CTA footer.
    LegalBriefSectionBuilder
    Pure domain service that builds a "Legal & Regulatory Brief" newsletter section from recent legal articles and regulatory events.
    NewsletterRenderer
    Renders a NewsletterDraft into two output formats for storage and delivery.
    NewsletterTeaserBuilder
    Builds a truncated "teaser" version of a full NewsletterRun for FREE-tier subscribers.
    ResearchPlanningService
    Domain service that decomposes a research query into a structured ResearchPlan by calling the AI model with a planning prompt.
    ResearchSynthesisService
    Domain service that converts a set of RetrievedSource documents and a ResearchPlan into a structured ResearchAnswer by calling the AI model with a synthesis prompt.
    ReversalWatchSectionBuilder
    Pure domain service that transforms a list of Contradiction records into a single NewsletterSection for the "Reversal Watch" newsletter feature.
    VendorAssessmentService
    Domain service that converts a set of RetrievedSource documents into a structured list of VendorAssessment records by calling the AI model with the vendor-compare prompt template.
